title: 2. Check conclusions one by one3. Do not assume anything extra

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Analyze every given conclusion independently and sequentially.
Base all deductions strictly on the given premise without incorporating external real-world knowledge.
Avoid making extra assumptions or extrapolating beyond the explicit context.
Competitive exam questions often trick candidates with real-world facts that are logically invalid based on the given text alone.
Always evaluate each conclusion one by one to avoid combining conditions across different options.
